entry_state: The uncertain-tax branches keep current and deferred amounts consistent under the stated fictional law. Only explicitly compatible operating cases are combined. Inspection replacement removes the old component before capitalizing the new inspection. The lease-reduction case now distinguishes surrendered rights from price changes and has removed ROU 20 and liability 25 for a gain 5; remeasurement of the surviving arrangement continues next.
exit_state: Lease termination and remeasurement have separate effects. Pension changes require event-date remeasurement, distinct profit/OCI effects and a reset interest basis; multi-employer information limits do not erase funding obligations. Opening WIP retains earlier cost and effort, and abnormal loss is separately expensed. The next pension-surplus section has introduced refund and contribution-reduction routes whose calculation continues on page 146.
findings: The lease case separates gain 5 from remeasurement 11 and follows remaining depreciation, interest and settlement to cash/equity 49.6.
Pension event ordering prevents both stale interest and netting profit against ceiling OCI merely because closing equity matches.
The multi-employer passage keeps classification, information availability and a separate deficit-funding contract distinct.
FIFO and weighted-average WIP preserve the same total cost 1560; the abnormal-loss example excludes 1000/19 rather than hiding it in good output. No new confirmed defect.
